lines.trans: What is this unscheduled family council?
Dad, sit down, I want to say something important.
Tell me honestly, are you pregnant right now?
Mom, no, I am not pregnant at all.
I am leaving soon to live in Paris.
Are you going there with that clown?
It would be better if you really were pregnant!
Has he already asked you to marry him?
No, so far he only invited me to Paris.
And what about your mother and me?
You lived wonderfully before my arrival.
And each of you lived on your own.

examples.text: Пусть сам смотрит нашу столицу.
examples.trans: Let him tour our capital on his own.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'according to', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Может, поедешь со мной в Париж?
examples.trans: Maybe you will go to Paris with me?

examples.text: По-моему, я уже жутко опаздываю.
examples.trans: In my opinion, I am already terribly late.

examples.text: Слышишь, это сработала пожарная сигнализация.
examples.trans: Listen, the fire alarm has gone off.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'to oneself', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Причём жили каждый сам по себе.
examples.trans: And each of you lived on your own.

examples.text: Элечка, дорогая, ну как ты себя чувствуешь?
examples.trans: Elechka, my dear, how are you feeling?

examples.text: Как всегда, мы думали только о себе.
examples.trans: As always, we thought only about ourselves.

meanings.en: nowhere, not anywhere (direction/destination, used with не or нет)
meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'nowhere', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Никуда она с ним не поедет!
examples.trans: She is not going anywhere with him!

examples.text: Какой банкет, я никуда не лечу!
examples.trans: What banquet, I am not flying anywhere!

examples.text: Слушайте, да не нужно вам никуда ехать.
examples.trans: Listen, you don't need to go anywhere.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'she', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Никуда она с ним не поедет!
examples.trans: She is not going anywhere with him!

examples.text: Она у нас уже взрослый человек.
examples.trans: She is already a grown adult.

examples.text: Она вправе сама принимать важные решения.
examples.trans: She has the right to make important decisions herself.

meanings.en: to go, to set off (by car, bus, train)
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'ехать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will go', paired with 'ехать'.

examples.text: Поехали лучше сейчас новый телевизор купим.
examples.trans: Let us go buy a new television right now instead.

examples.text: Мы поедем домой.
examples.trans: We'll go home.

examples.text: Ладно, Аркашенька. Мы поедем, пора.
examples.trans: All right, Arkashenka. We'll be off, it's time.
